load_sonata_model: load the sonata model from facebook/sonata repo with optional flash attention support
load_linear_prob_head: load a linear probing segmentation head checkpoint and initialize SegHead with its config
run_semantic_segmentation: run semantic segmentation inference on a point cloud using sonata backbone and seg head
transform_point_cloud_data: apply default sonata transform pipeline to point cloud data before inference
visualize_segmented_point_cloud: visualize a segmented point cloud with class colors using open3d geometry
